description: Utility functions for formatting strings within a frontend application, including functions to convert strings to camelCase and Title Case, handling various delimiters, punctuation, and accents.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling spaces, underscores, and hyphens, collapsing multiple whitespaces, trimming, and preserving original value for non-strings.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, replacing delimiters with spaces, collapsing whitespaces, handling apostrophes and accented characters, and capitalizing appropriate characters for display.
